methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch on 2026-06-14. monthlyUsd reflects the effective monthly cost at the smallest billable unit (one seat / one workspace) under the default published billing cycle. Where both annual and monthly billing are published, monthlyUsd uses the annual-billing monthly rate (lower/displayed-first rate) and the month-to-month rate is noted in plan notes; annualDiscountPct is calculated from those two rates. Plans marked 'Contact sales' or with no self-serve checkout carry monthlyUsd=null. Zendesk's pricing page consistently geo-redirected to a German EUR page (zendesk.de) and no USD figures could be confirmed from the official source; Zendesk is therefore excluded rather than publishing unverified converted amounts. GetApp listing pages were used as corroboration sources where available. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical.
